senses.gloss: माया- + धर माया- + धर, adj. fraudulent, Rām. 3, 49, 17.
मायाधर माया-धर, adj. Deceitful, disguised, Rām. 3, 49, 17.

† मय् मय्, i. 1, Ātm. To go.
 --Cf. perhaps Lat. meare; see मी.

मय मय, m.
 1. A camel.
 2. A mule.

माय माय, i. e. मन् + य,
 I. m.
 1. A juggler.
 2. An Asura.
 II. f.
 1. Understanding.
 2. Fraud, deceit, Man. 7, 104; Hit. i. d. 194, M.M.
 3. Trick in negotiation, diplomacy, Pañc. i. d. 404 (यो मायां कुरुते मूधः प्राणत्यागे धनादिषु, The fool who uses tricks about wealth, etc., his life being in danger).
 4. Wickedness.
 5. Illusion, unreality, Vedāntas. in Chr. 205, 2.
 6. Magical power, Kathās. 25, 274.
 7. Compassion.
 8. The wife of a juggler.
 --Comp.
मयु मयु, m. The name of a class of attendants on Kuvera.

मायु मायु,
 I. m. Bile.
 II. i. e. 2. मा + उ, Sounding, crying, at the end of comp. words; ved. गोमायु see s. v.

मयूख मयूख, m.
 1. A ray of light, Pañc. i. d. 92.
 2. Light, splendour, Ṛt. 6, 29.
 3. Beauty.
 --Comp.

मयूर मयूर,
 I. m.
 1. A peacock, Hit. i. d. 178, M.M.
 2. The name of a flower and of a plant.
 II. f. री, A peahen, Utt. Rāmac. 55, 8.

मायूर मायूर, i. e. मयूर + अ,
 I. adj., f. री.
 1. Belonging to, or coming from, peacocks, Rām. 2, 100, 63 Gorr.; agreeable to peacocks, Mālav. d. 20.
 2. Made of its feathers.
 II. n. A flock of peacocks.
मयोभू मयोभू, i. e. मयस् (ved. Enjoyment), -भू, adj. Yielding enjoyment, Chr. 295, 18 = Rigv. i. 92, 18.
मायाद माया-द (vb. दा), m. A crocodile.

मायामय माया + मय, adj., f. यी,
 1. Illusive, Rām. 3, 49, 31.
 2. Magical, Indr. 1, 7; Rām. 3, 55, 31.

मायावन्त् माया + वन्त्,
 I. adj., f. वती, Deceitful, illusory, unreal.
 II. m. A name of Kansa.
 III. f. वती, The wife of Kāma.

मायायिन् मायायिन्, and मायाविन् मायाविन्, i. e. माया + विन्,
 I. adj.
 1. Deceitful, using tricks, Rām. 3, 49, 47 (विन्).
 2. Illusory, unreal.
 II. m.
 1. A juggler.
 2. A cat.
मायिक मायिक, i. e. माया + इक, m. A juggler.

मायिन् मायिन्, i. e. माया + इन्,
 I. adj.
 1. Wise, Chr. 290, 7 = Rigv. i. 64, 7.
 2. Deceptive.
 II. m.
 1. A juggler.
 2. A cheat.
 3. Agni, Viṣṇu, Brahman.
 --Comp.
माया- + मृग माया- + मृग, m. seeming a deer, not being one really, Rām. 3, 49, 21.
